name: memrain
description: Connect Codex to your Memrain memory over MCP: search, read and write pages, facts and timelines shared across sessions, plus a small set of skills for working with it.

interface.shortDescription: Shared memory for your agents over MCP
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to a Memrain server: search, pages, facts, timelines and the entity graph, kept across sessions and shared with your other agents. The server runs on your own AWS account or on this machine (`make local-up`, keyword-only, no AWS). Export BRAIN_MCP_TOKEN with a personal access token before starting Codex.
defaultPrompt: Search my Memrain memory for what we know about this project
